description.zh: 对照样张的厚笔画与留白，再核下载指向和原许可。 按字形类别和用途标签浏览的字体资源入口，目录用样张呈现字体，详情列作品图及下载控件。本次已取得 Chomage 的 OTF、TTF 与随包说明，原包明确个人和商业使用免费；此结论仅限该包，更多原作者网页条款读取失败，字体再分发等其他权限未核。
description.en: A font resource organized by type categories and use labels, with specimen cards and detail pages showing artwork and download controls. This visit obtained Chomage OTF and TTF files and the accompanying statement granting free personal and commercial use. That applies only to this package; the designer-license webpage could not be read, and other permissions such as redistribution remain unverified.
